title: Bayesian Prediction in Gamma Models: Admissibility and Infinitesimal Prediction
summary: We study estimation and prediction in the Gamma model $\mathrm{Ga}(α,β)$, where the shape parameter $α$ is known and the scale parameter $β$ is unknown, under the Kullback--Leibler loss. For $α\le1$, all scale-invariant estimators of $β$ have infinite risk, indicating a qualitative change in the estimation problem at the boundary $α=1$. Our main result is that the Bayesian predictive density based on the Jeffreys prior is admissible for all $α>0$.
